name: pappu-mods
description: Claude Code mods by pappusinghadip: cache and context meter, screen guard for recordings, a /goal progress bar, and an edit guard for parallel chats

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Cache and context bars above the prompt, keep-warm and one-click handoff

plugins.name: screen-guard
plugins.description: /rec masks secrets on screen and keeps secret files closed while you record

plugins.name: goal-tracker
plugins.description: A live /goal progress bar with task tooltips, ETA and subagent rows

plugins.name: edit-guard
plugins.description: Asks before editing a file another open chat changed recently
